```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(mnsentinellakes)

```

```{r load compiled beach data}

setwd("G:/My Drive/Research/beaches/data/")

# Two beaches don't have a DOW - Minnetonka swim pond and Elm creek swim pond
# messes up fixlakeid() --> remove

beaches <- read.csv("./processed/combined/All_beaches_new_100225_openrefine.csv") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  filter(!is.na(dow)) %>% # remove swim ponds (don't have DOWs)
  mutate(dow = fixlakeid(dow)) %>%
  mutate(date = as.POSIXct(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))  %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  mutate(month = month(date)) %>%
  mutate(jday = yday(date)) %>%
  mutate(week = week(date)) 
  # filter(date > "2010-01-01" & date < "2025-01-01") # select to dates with most data

closed <- beaches %>%
  filter(closure_yn == "Y")

```

```{r recalculate closures with new thresholds}


beaches_new <- beaches   %>%
  mutate(
    closure_yn = if_else(
      condition = ecoli_1d_gm > 235,
      true = "Y",
      false = "N")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    closure_reason = if_else(
      condition = ecoli_1d_gm > 235,
      true = "ecoli_1dayGM",
      false = NA)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    closure_yn = if_else(
      condition = ecoli_30d_gm > 126,
      true = "Y",
      false = "N")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    closure_reason = if_else(
      condition = ecoli_30d_gm > 126,
      true = "ecoli_30dayGM",
      false = closure_reason)
  ) 


# this overprints the 30day on top of the 1 day closures --> what to do if both conditions are met?


closed_new <- beaches_new %>%
  filter(closure_yn == "Y")

  
```

```{r which beaches close the most often}

# table of number of beach closures per beach in whole dataset
beach.summary <- beaches %>% 
  group_by(beach_name) %>%
    summarize(startYear = min(year), 
              endYear = max(year),
              numSamples = n()) 


closed.summary <- closed %>% 
  group_by(beach_name) %>%
    summarize(numClosures = n()) 



combined.summary <- left_join(beach.summary, closed.summary) %>%
  mutate(percClosed = round((numClosures/numSamples) *100)) %>%
  arrange(desc(percClosed))
combined.summary


mostclosedlist <- combined.summary$BeachName[1:10]


# none that are never closed --> NA (not zero)

setwd("G:/My Drive/Research/beaches/data/processed")
write.csv(combined.summary, "./combined/beachSummary.csv", row.names = FALSE)


closed.summary.detailed <- closed %>% 
  group_by(beach_name, year) %>%
    summarize(numClosures = n())

# will depend on how often it is sampled
```

```{r daily climate data}

setwd("G:/My Drive/Research/beaches/data/")

dclim <- read.csv("./other_variables/daily_precip.csv") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  mutate(max_temp_degC = (as.numeric(maximum_temperature_degrees_f) - 32) *(5/9)) %>%
  mutate(min_temp_degC = (as.numeric(minimum_temperature_degrees_f) - 32) *(5/9)) %>%
  mutate(precip_mm = as.numeric(precipitation_inches)* 25.4) %>%  # Trace precip (T) becomes NA
  select(date, precip_mm, max_temp_degC, min_temp_degC) %>%
  filter(date >= "2010-01-01" & date < "2025-01-01")


dclim$ante5dptot <- 0
dclim$ante5avgmaxt <- 0

# rolling 5 day climate
for (i in 1:length(dclim$date)) {
  intervalstart <- as.POSIXct(dclim$date[i] - 5) #rolling window 5 days before
  intervalend <-  as.POSIXct(dclim$date[i])
  
  span5d <-  dclim %>%
    filter(date >= intervalstart & date <= intervalend) # select all data 5 days 
  
  dclim$ante5dptot[i] <- sum(span5d$precip_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  dclim$ante5avgmaxt[i] <- mean(span5d$max_temp_degC, na.rm = TRUE)
}

summary(dclim)
```

```{r precip specifics}

# closures by year
closed.plot <- ggplot(closed, aes(x=Year)) + 
  geom_bar(fill = "grey40") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  xlim(2009,2025) +
  ylab("Number of beach closures")

# annual precip
precip.plot <- ggplot(precip, aes(x=Year, y=Annual_mm)) + 
  geom_line(linewidth=2, color="blue") +
  # ylim(0, 1200) +  
  xlim(2009,2025) +
  theme_bw()

precip.plot /closed.plot 

# monthly precip
monthlyprecip.plot <- ggplot(precip, aes(x=Year)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y=May_mm), color = "lightblue",linewidth = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y=Jun_mm), color = "deepskyblue",linewidth = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y=Jul_mm), color = "steelblue",linewidth = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y=Aug_mm), color = "blue",linewidth = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y=Sep_mm), color = "darkblue",linewidth = 2) +
  ylab("Montly Precip (mm)") 

  
monthlyprecip.plot /closed.plot 


```

```{r temperature}

# calculate aveage summer temp

tempavg$Summer <- 0
for( i in 1:length(tempavg$Year)) {
  tempavg$Summer[i] <- mean(tempavg$May[i], tempavg$Jun[i], tempavg$Jul[i], tempavg$Aug[i])
}

tempavg.plot <- ggplot(tempavg, aes(x=Year, y=Summer)) + 
  geom_line(color = "gold", linewidth = 2) +
  xlim(2009,2025) +
  ylab("Mean SummerTemp (deg F)") +
  theme_bw()


monthlytempavg.plot <- ggplot(tempavg, aes(x=Year)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y=May), color = "darkgreen",linewidth = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y=Jun), color = "green",linewidth = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y=Jul), color = "gold",linewidth = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y=Aug), color = "darkorange",linewidth = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y=Sep), color = "red",linewidth = 2) +
  ylab("Average Monthly Temperature (deg F)") +
  theme_bw()


# summer average max temperature
tempmax$Summer <- 0
for( i in 1:length(tempmax$Year)) {
  tempmax$Summer[i] <- mean(tempmax$May[i], tempmax$Jun[i], tempmax$Jul[i], tempmax$Aug[i])
}

tempmax.plot <- ggplot(tempmax, aes(x=Year, y=Summer)) +

  ylab("Summer Maximum Temp (deg F)") +

monthlytempmax.plot <- ggplot(tempmax, aes(x=Year)) +

  geom_line(aes(y=Aug), color = "darkorange",linewidth = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y=Sep), color = "red",linewidth = 2) +
  ylab("Maximum Monthly Temperature (deg F)") 



monthlyavgtemp.plot/ monthlyprecip.plot /closed.plot
```
